Subpackage Loading

You might say

Can this mini program open its home screen before downloading the rarely used support pages?

A mechanism that separates mini program code into a main package and subpackages loaded when needed·A shop’s home screen can live in the main package while its return and repair pages live in a support subpackage. Entering support can then load that package. Downloading page code is separate from fetching order data.
Know first
Mini ProgramFile
Subpackage
Which code loads before the home screen?
Code package downloadsTeaching example · first visit

Main package

  • pages/home
  • Shared components
  • pages/return
  • pages/repair
Downloaded
Open home → download main
main includes home, returns, and repairs

Even a home-only visit initially downloads the support code in the same package.

What belongs in each package?

Keep the entry and shared resources in the main package: The entry screen and resources needed across ordinary subpackages remain available from the main package. A feature’s pages and private resources can move together.

Load according to the feature being opened: Opening a page in a subpackage can trigger its download. Preloading and caching can change the actual timing; inspect download records rather than assuming it.

Does subpackaging make order requests faster?

Subpackaging does not speed up slow API requests or reduce total code by itself. Size limits and independent-subpackage rules vary by platform and should be checked in the current documentation.
